summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Mafia restart button (testID='mafia-restart-btn'). All 10 scripted checks passed: button is hidden on intro, visible on players/roleCounts/distribution/reveal phases, confirm dialog shows the exact Arabic message, cancel keeps state, confirm resets phase->intro/round->1/roleCounts all 0/players empty/winner null while preserving playerNames, and re-entering via mafia-start-button shows the 6 saved names L1..L6. AsyncStorage snapshot inspected and verified.

issues: restart icon button bounding box is 42x42 which is just below the recommended 44x44 mobile touch-target. Tappable in practice but consider bumping to >=44px.

critical_code_review_comments: restartGame() correctly preserves playerNames and resets all other slices including nightActionsRef.current. Save effect persists the new (clean) snapshot to AsyncStorage automatically.
Confirm dialog uses window.confirm on web with the exact requested Arabic copy and Alert.alert on native — good cross-platform handling.
File mafia.tsx is 2149 lines — consider splitting sub-screens into separate files for maintainability (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created 6 in-memory players L1..L6 during test; cleared via restartGame so no persisted seed remains beyond playerNames (intentional).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mafia restart button feature verified end-to-end on web preview at viewport 414x900. To re-verify: clear localStorage, tap mafia-start-button, advance phases, override window.confirm to return false (cancel) then true (confirm), then inspect localStorage['mafia_game_state_v1'].
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature works as specified. No bugs to RCA.
